Overview.Name: Rashmini Donthu
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or berries)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & leafy vegetable curry + curd (small bowl)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd + leafy vegetables
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (100–120 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS, always start meals with eggs or chicken before eating rice.
When cravings hit, eat a proper meal first and wait 10 minutes before taking anything extra.
Avoid fried and bakery foods as they worsen hormonal imbalance.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support fat loss and hormone balance.
Daily walking will help improve PCOS symptoms and overall energy.
